major_cooldowns.name: Deathmark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press Deathmark on cooldown once Garrote and Rupture are ticking, your Envenom buff is up and Kingsbane is about to come off cooldown, and fire trinkets and racials inside it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 360194 is the cast and the enemy debuff; 1248010 shares the name but was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Kingsbane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Kingsbane immediately after Deathmark so the doubled poison applications ramp its damage-over-time faster, and send the off-window one on cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 385627 is the cast; 394095 is the self-buff half of the same effect.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use Vanish inside Deathmark and follow it with Garrote for the empowered Improved Garrote, or hold it when a chain pull or add wave is close.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1856 is the cast; 11327 is the stealth aura it applies.

major_cooldowns.name: Shiv
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: With Toxic Stiletto, press Shiv as a cheap generator when you are one combo point short of the cap in pure single target.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast in 2/5 sampled parses; only Toxic Stiletto builds press it rotationally.

major_cooldowns.name: Thistle Tea
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink Thistle Tea when you are energy starved, and spend the remaining charges before the fight ends.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; 3 charges.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Press Cloak of Shadows to clear magic damage-over-time effects and eat a scripted magic hit.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use Evasion when you are taking physical melee damage you cannot walk out of.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Heal chip damage with Crimson Vial between hits, not during your Deathmark window where the energy is worth more.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Press Feint just before a raid-wide area hit lands to cut the damage.

rules.description: Bleeds up before Deathmark and Kingsbane
rules.action: Get Garrote and Rupture ticking first, then press Deathmark and follow it straight with Kingsbane.

rules.description: Hold Kingsbane and Vanish for Deathmark
rules.action: Bank Kingsbane and Vanish for the Deathmark window instead of firing them just before it comes up.
Follow every Vanish with Garrote so the Improved Garrote version lands, then extend it with a second Garrote.

rules.description: Deathmark only with the Envenom buff up
rules.action: Dump your combo points with Envenom right before you open the Deathmark window.
Build to full combo points before you press Envenom, and go to the cap while Darkest Night is up.

rules.description: Keep Rupture on your main target
rules.action: Reapply Rupture at full combo points as soon as it is refreshable on your main target.

rules.description: Keep Garrote on your main target
rules.action: Reapply Garrote the moment it drops, since every other bleed and poison scales off it.

rules.description: Refresh Garrote late, do not clip it
rules.action: Refresh Garrote inside its pandemic window, and only overwrite it early to snapshot Improved Garrote.

rules.description: Crimson Tempest only on multiple targets
rules.action: Spend the energy on Crimson Tempest to spread bleeds on packs, and build with Mutilate on a lone target.

rules.description: Chain Envenom late in its own buff
rules.action: Press Envenom as the current buff is about to expire, and burn energy freely during your cooldowns instead.

source_summary: Assassination builds everything around Deathmark: keep Garrote and Rupture ticking, refresh the Envenom buff, then press Deathmark on cooldown with Kingsbane immediately behind it so the doubled poison applications ramp its damage-over-time. Vanish is an Improved Garrote enabler that belongs inside the same window, and trinkets, racials and potions all go with Deathmark. Outside cooldowns the spec is energy limited, so spend Envenom at maximum combo points late in the current Envenom buff and swap to Crimson Tempest and Fan of Knives only once several enemies are up.
